entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair clamp(value, lower, upper): return value bounded by the inclusive lower and upper limits. Raise ValueError when lower exceeds upper. Inputs are integers. Do not change the public function name. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def clamp(value, lower, upper):

entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair rotate_left(items, steps): return a new list rotated left by integer steps modulo the list length. Negative steps rotate right. Empty input returns a new empty list. Preserve elements and do not mutate the input. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def rotate_left(items, steps):
    return items[steps:] + items[:steps]

    return {v:[k] for k,v in record.items()}
